option_relations.rationale: Eosinophilic annular erythema (EAE) is a distinct dermatological condition, not directly related to the provided leaf which describes a drug-induced eczematous dermatitis.

Wells syndrome (eosinophilic cellulitis) is a specific inflammatory skin condition characterized by eosinophilic infiltration, but it is not directly related to the provided leaf which describes a drug-induced eczematous dermatitis.
Granuloma annulare is a benign inflammatory skin condition characterized by annular lesions, but it is not directly related to the provided leaf which describes a drug-induced eczematous dermatitis.

Drug-induced erythema annulare centrifugum is a specific drug reaction pattern, but it is not directly related to the provided leaf which describes a drug-induced eczematous dermatitis. While both are drug-induced, the specific dermatological manifestations are different.
